Inherited B2/G obstructions remain INDEPENDENTLY-CHECKED (Gate-A PASS OB-20/OB-22 + checkers OB-21/OB-17); H's own increment does not advance. First Li_1 witness (0.019913 vs 0.019855) CONFIRMED.
